result.verdict: CONFIRMED (scope-(a) structural narrowing): the Q_beta evaluation map E(w) = h^2/2 - h*w is AFFINE in the crossing weight w, so the ladder factor L(w) = E(w)/E(w0) is Moebius in w and its bar-ODD (decay) part is EXACTLY 2h*(w - w0)/(4*w0^2 - h^2) -- LINEAR in the crossing-weight departure (w - w0) times the FIXED bar-odd kernel K(q) = 2h/(4*w0^2 - h^2). The evaluation map introduces neither nonlinearity nor anchor-dependence into the odd channel; the whole c_k odd-channel signature (incl. the c_3 -> -2 shadow) is the image of the single scalar bar-even departure (w - w0) under K(q). Since K(q) is a fixed rational function of q, the c_3 anchor-swing must live entirely in w(q). Sharpens KC18 (numerator split) to the ladder factor where the c_k live. NO c_k value; nothing wired.
